metaDescription: Kevin reports a map listing a Flock camera inside prison showers at the Silverdale Detention Center in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
summary: Kevin reports that a map shows a camera labeled CF23 Foxtrot, described as a male holding area with two showers, at the coordinates of the Silverdale Detention Center in Chattanooga, Tennessee. According to Kevin, this means Flock cameras are installed inside the showers of prisons, as detailed by the map he cites.
